LVGLab 0.3.1 keeps the timeline next to the project, adds Spanish and French, and fixes issues found in a review.

## Downloads

| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 (x64) | `LVGLab-0.3.1-windows-x64.zip` |
| Linux (x64, glibc 2.35+) | `LVGLab-0.3.1-linux-x64.tar.gz` |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `LVGLab-0.3.1-macos-arm64.tar.gz` |
| macOS (Intel) | `LVGLab-0.3.1-macos-x64.tar.gz` |

Unpack and start `lvglab` (`lvglab.exe` on Windows); no installation needed. Check downloads against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
On macOS, run `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine lvglab` once if the unsigned binary is refused.

## New

- The timeline is saved as `<name>.timeline` next to the project and restored on open; each step stores only
  what changed, so the project file holds just the current state
- Spanish and French user interface

## Fixed

- Timeline labels describe changes inside components
- Statistics no longer hang on a component that contains an instance of itself
- The export warns about instances of missing components and about duplicate component names
- A lost screenshot no longer stops a GIF recording
- The export button fits into the menu bar
